ModMetaData.name: Shipcracker Warcasket
ModMetaData.author: Sam Hunt
ModMetaData.description:
Adds the Shipcracker, a late-game boarding warcasket for VFE Pirates, welded at the warcasket foundry like any other set.
Its drop thrusters power the Breach Jump, which punches through roofs and walls on landing. In space (Odyssey), they power the Breach Burn: unlimited range, anywhere in line of sight.
Odyssey is optional. Compatible with Save Our Ship 2 and Vanilla Gravship Expanded. Requires Vanilla Factions Expanded - Pirates.
